title: Principal
description: Institution-local actor that authenticates through a host or a service credential.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

person_id.description: Human's educational identity. Null for service actors.

last_authenticated_at.description: Last successfully bound authentication time. Administrative visibility only.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: Human requires a Person. A service has no Person or learner enrollment.
More than one authorized Principal may map to a Person. Academic records attach to Person.
Suspension does not automatically unsuspend or reactivate linked Person or credential.
